Do you have a passion for research and development? Are you eager to learn about the technology behind Lubricant Oil Additives and their application? Are you open to new opportunities and keen to develop yourself further? Read more below and find out that BRB is looking for you! 
 HBO 
 40 uur per week 
 Wat ga je doen 
What is the job about? 
In addition to supporting various research projects, you will also be responsible for the operational activities and organization of the laboratory. You identify gaps in current work processes and procedures and make suggestions for further improvements. 
You work on new as well as existing products and raw materials. You carry out a wide range of physical, chemical, analytical and performance tests, while collecting and reporting results. You do so in an effective and timely manner, prioritizing and meeting deadlines. 
You are responsible for the incoming control of research samples, ordering chemicals and consumables as well as equipment maintenance and calibration. You troubleshoot and diagnose equipment and systems for emergency repairs and carry out preventive maintenance inspections. It is important to balance lab organization and maintenance needs with the project workload while promoting a safe work environment and avoiding downtime. 
You will be doing hands-on research in the lab for about 80-90 % of your time. 
The team 
The R&D team you will join is fairly small and consists of six colleagues. It is a multicultural team and the working language is English. In this position you work closely with your colleagues and report directly to the line manager.

What's in it for you?

Within a dynamic 24/7 environment, dedicated employees work daily to ensure an efficient and reliable logistics process for customers in the Netherlands and Belgium. Function 
You are responsible for docking trucks that need to be loaded and moving loaded trailers and trucks to the parking area. Additionally, you prepare vehicles for departure and ensure the safe maneuvering of trucks and trailers on and around the premises. Since public roads are used between different locations, a valid CE driving license with Code 95 is required. You will primarily work during evening and night hours and contribute to a smooth and safe logistics process. For this, you will receive a generous hourly wage. Requirements
